questions.question: Letter writing is a kind of written communication composed in which style?
questions.explanation: Letter writing is defined as a kind of written communication composed in prose.

questions.question: Letter writing is considered one of the oldest means of which activity?
questions.explanation: Letter writing is described as one of the oldest means of communication.

questions.question: Letter writing enables people to send information and materials despite which obstacle?
questions.explanation: Letter writing helps people communicate despite their physical separation.

questions.question: Letter writing saves time and facilitates which outcome?
questions.explanation: The text states that letter writing saves time and facilitates progress.

questions.question: Which advantage of letter writing provides an opportunity for full expression?
questions.explanation: Letter writing provides the opportunity for analyzing and full expression of messages.

questions.question: In business life, a letter can serve as which of the following?
questions.explanation: In business life, a letter can be the basis or evidence of an agreement or contract.

questions.question: Which advantage of letter writing allows it to serve as a reminder of information?
questions.explanation: A physical letter can serve as a reminder of the information expressed.

questions.question: Which of the following is a main type of letter recognized in contemporary society?
questions.explanation: The two main types of letters are informal and formal letters.

questions.question: Formal letters are also known by which other name?
questions.explanation: Formal letters are also called business, official, or public letters.

questions.question: Informal letters are written to people with whom the writer has which type of relationship?
questions.explanation: Informal letters are written to people with whom we are familiar or in intimate relationships.

questions.question: The style of informal letters is usually described in which manner?
questions.explanation: The style of informal letters is usually very informal, casual, and conversational.

questions.question: Which of the following individuals would most likely receive an informal letter?
questions.explanation: Informal letters are written to relatives like brothers, sisters, or cousins.

questions.question: Which element appears in the top right corner of an informal letter?
questions.explanation: The writer's address appears in the top-right corner of the page.

questions.question: The writer's name should not be written alongside which element?
questions.explanation: The writer should not write his or her name alongside the address.

questions.question: Which of the following is part of the structure of an informal letter?
questions.explanation: The date of the letter is the second structural element of an informal letter.

questions.question: The ending of an informal letter includes the complimentary close and which other item?
questions.explanation: The ending includes both the complimentary close and the name of the writer.

questions.question: Which component of an informal letter shows intimacy and is written by the left hand corner?
questions.explanation: The salutation shows intimacy and is written a space or two below the address by the left hand corner.

questions.question: Which element directly follows the writer's address in the structure of an informal letter?
questions.explanation: The date is written under the writer's address.

questions.question: In the slanted format of an address, the lines are indented towards which direction?
questions.explanation: In the slanted format, the lines of the address are indented progressively to the right-hand side.

questions.question: Which format of writing an address does not use indentation?
questions.explanation: In the block format, the address lines are not indented.

questions.question: The writer's address can be written using which two main forms?
questions.explanation: The writer's address can be written in the slant or progressive form and the block form.

questions.question: A block format address is typically associated with which style?
questions.explanation: The text shows an example of a block with open style.

questions.question: The date in an informal letter is written under which section?
questions.explanation: The date in an informal letter is written under the writer's address.

questions.question: Which punctuation mark is advisable to add at the end of a date?
questions.explanation: It is advisable nowadays that a full stop or period should be added at the end of the date.

questions.question: Adjectival markers like st and th are written on which lines?
questions.explanation: Adjectival markers are written on the same lines as the day.

questions.question: Which of the following represents an acceptable way to write a date?
questions.explanation: The text lists 14-08-2022 as a correct date form.

questions.question: Which of the following correctly illustrates the placement of adjectival markers in a date?
questions.explanation: Adjectival markers are written on the same line as the day.

questions.question: The salutation is typically written at which part of the page?
questions.explanation: The salutation should be written a space or two below the address, but by the left-hand corner.

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable salutation for an informal letter?
questions.explanation: My dear Abba or Dear Abba is an acceptable informal salutation.

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable salutation for an older friend?
questions.explanation: Dear Sir is used to older friends in Standard Nigerian English.

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable salutation for academic doctors?
questions.explanation: Dear Doc or Dr is used for academic doctors only.

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable salutation for medical doctors?
questions.explanation: Dear Doctor is used for medical doctors only.

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable salutation for an older female friend?
questions.explanation: Dear Madam is an acceptable salutation for older female friends.

questions.question: Which of the following salutations is incorrect because it lacks a surname?
questions.explanation: You should not write Dear Mr, Dear Mrs alone without the surname.

questions.question: Which of the following correctly pairs a salutation with its intended recipient?
questions.explanation: Dear Professor or Dear Prof is the correct salutation for professors.

questions.question: The body of an informal letter should be written in which tone?
questions.explanation: The body should be written in an informal tone and conversational language.

questions.question: Which of the following language forms is permitted in the body of an informal letter?
questions.explanation: The use of idioms, colloquialisms, slangs, and contracted forms is permitted.

questions.question: How should the body of an informal letter be arranged?
questions.explanation: The body should be written in an indented or block paragraph.

questions.question: Repeating the salutation in the body of the letter is considered which of the following?
questions.explanation: It is not necessary to keep repeating the salutation in the body of the letter.

questions.question: The ending of a personal letter includes the name of the writer and which other element?
questions.explanation: The ending includes both the complimentary close and the name of the writer.

questions.question: The complimentary close is written from which position on the page?
questions.explanation: It is usually written from the center of the page towards the right end of the letter.

questions.question: In the complimentary close, only which part of the writer's name is usually written?
questions.explanation: Only the first name of the writer as known by the receiver is usually written.

questions.question: Which of the following is a common complimentary close for an informal letter?
questions.explanation: The most common complimentary close used is Yours sincerely or Yours affectionately.

questions.question: Which spelling of the possessive word is correct for a complimentary close?
questions.explanation: The possessive Yours is not contracted as Your's.

questions.question: Which of the following is an acceptable complimentary close depending on the relationship?
questions.explanation: The complimentary close could depend on the relationship so that Your lovely and Your ever are also permitted.

questions.question: Formal letters are written to achieve which purpose?
questions.explanation: Formal letters are written to achieve specific purposes in official matters.

questions.question: Which of the following language forms should be avoided in formal letters?
questions.explanation: Slangs and colloquial expressions are completely avoided in formal letters.

questions.question: Which type of language should be adopted when writing formal letters?
questions.explanation: Appropriate registers, simple and straightforward language should be adopted.

questions.question: The tone of a formal letter should primarily show which quality?
questions.explanation: The tone should show respect, since such a letter is mainly for official purposes.

questions.question: Formal letters are also known by which specific term?
questions.explanation: Formal letters are also called public letters, although these letters are not always for the public to read.
